programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. The bad news is that Dethklok is now faced with the daunting task of cooking dinner themselves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an attempt to make their next album the most brutal ever, Dethklok commissions a Russian nuclear submarine to record deep in the Nordic waters. Underwater, the band copes with seasickness, whale and radar pings infecting their tracks, and loss of food and oxygen.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. Dethklok doesn't care until they learn that the Troll is knocking out all DSL lines, making their Internet really slow. Dethklok must write the world's first Death Metal Lullaby to put the demonic beast back to sleep.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a legendary bad move, Dethklok decides to do standup comedy. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of Dethklok learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate. Dethklok finds that they are very much naturals at this. The physical comedy routine they work out really kills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. The guys are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of their "Parents of Dethklok" album, but are then impressed by the depth of their parents' anger.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular ROCK AND ROLL clown makes a holiday appearance. Part of season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface wants the easy life but still wants all the rewards. After the band decides to kick him out for making their jobs more difficult, Murderface realizes the EASIEST way to make BIG money is to start his own label.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Drunk driving HOVER DRUMS and causing billions in damage Pickles the drummer is thrown into rehab and his worst nightmares are realized when he is replaced- by a drum machine.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. But as the evidence of her past piles up, to prove her innocence, he follows her to the most brutal place on earth: Klokikon - the annual Dethklok fan convention filled with cosplay geeks and homosexual fan art. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. Meanwhile, Toki, after being left behind, starts a special club that promotes equality and love but excludes Murderface because he doesn't have the right look.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. Nathan, however, can't shake the feeling that something is wrong with the record... After being humiliated by Murderface's prank calls, Skwisgaar and Toki swear revenge.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. The bad news is that Dethklok is now faced with the daunting task of cooking dinner themselves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an attempt to make their next album the most brutal ever, Dethklok commissions a Russian nuclear submarine to record deep in the Nordic waters. Underwater, the band copes with seasickness, whale and radar pings infecting their tracks, and loss of food and oxygen.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. Dethklok doesn't care until they learn that the Troll is knocking out all DSL lines, making their Internet really slow. Dethklok must write the world's first Death Metal Lullaby to put the demonic beast back to sleep.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a legendary bad move, Dethklok decides to do standup comedy. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of Dethklok learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate. Dethklok finds that they are very much naturals at this. The physical comedy routine they work out really kills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. The guys are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of their "Parents of Dethklok" album, but are then impressed by the depth of their parents' anger.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

Everyone is supposed to be on their best behavior, but The Monarch can't resist the temptation to wreak havoc once he finds himself inside the "belly of the beast"... nor can he find a bathroom.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When Brock and Dr. Venture are kidnapped from the funeral of a college friend, the boys enlist the aid of the original Team Venture: a group of superscience adventurers who worked for their grandfather in the sixties.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Monarch is on trial for the one crime he may not have committed, under mysterious circumstances stemming from his bitter breakup with Dr. Girlfriend. The boys and Dr. Orpheus are forced to testify, but only Brock is aware that something far more sinister is afoot.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture finally learns the secret of his recurring womb nightmares when a stomach tumor turns out to be something far more sinister.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Powerless in the Face of Death

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Aided by Henchmen 21, 24 and a ragtag band of roughneck new recruits, The Monarch attempts to rebuild his villainous empire and rekindle his relationship with Dr. Girlfriend. A showdown at the local shopping mall forces his hand, and as he struggles to choose between revenge and reconciliation amidst a sea of violence, a wounded Brock falls into the clutches of The Phantom Limb.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When Brock is reactivated by the Office of Secret Intelligence to track down a rogue agent, he subcontracts his ex-girlfriend, the malevolently mercenary Molotov Cocktease, to protect the Venture Compound from enemies within and without. Love is in the air! Or is it... murder?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Escape To The House Of Mummies (Part 2)
programme.desc: Team Venture find themselves trapped in the clutches of a bloodthirsty Egyptian cult.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Phantom Limb and Dr. Girlfriend agree to a civil double date with The Monarch and some girl he met on the internet in order to discuss The Monarch's official re-entry into the Guild of Calamitous Intent. Doc and Brock become the unwitting pawns in a low-grade pissing contest when Phantom Limb's sics the Guild's commandos on the Venture compound to prove his dominance. Can Brock hold off an army? Can Doc escape death and finish watching the worst porno ever?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Baron Underbheit captures Team Venture when the X-1 crash lands in Underland while en route from a superscience costume party. Rather than execute them immediately, he inflicts an unspeakable torture upon them: they're forced to attend his wedding.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When the Guild of Calamitous Intent finally approves Dr. Orpheus for his very own arch nemesis he calls upon old friends The Alchemist and Jefferson Twilight to resurrect their former super-team, The Order of the Triad. While they audition supervillain candidates at the Venture Compound, a jealous Doc isn't about to let Orpheus steal the show. Let loose the Walking Eye!

programme.desc: The mysterious blinking band aid on Bud Manstrong's head might be the key to a mystery only the ghost of Abraham Lincoln and Team Venture can solve.

programme.sub-title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Kills

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: As Phantom Limb makes his stunning power play, only Brock can rally The Monarch's forces to mount a defense. The fate of almost everyone in the Venture universe hangs in the balance as The Sovereign reveals his true identity and guys and stuff explode all over the place.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Shadowman 9: In the Cradle of Destiny

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: At long last, The Venture Bros. peels away the onion-like shrouds of time for a look back into the troubled past of America's most beloved hydrocephalic former boy genius, to reveal dark secrets that even he didn't know about. What could Pete White have been hiding from him for all these years? And why is Brock in on the cover-up?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Hate is

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Love is in the air, kind of, when Dr. Venture encounters his childhood friend, Dr. Tara Quymn, in the Amazon Rain Forest. But while Rusty puts the moves on his old play date, Hank makes a play for Dr. Quymn's twin daughters, Nancy and Drew, who in turn, only have eyes for Dean. And the Quymn's bodyguard, Ginnie, is hot for Brock. Maybe. But all of their romantic interludes will have to be put aside when the terror of the Wereodile threatens their camp.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: What Goes Down Must Come Up
programme.desc: All basements are kinda spooky, but the Ventures are about to learn the hard way that beneath the foundations of the Venture Compound lie deep, dark secrets... great and small. Only the one-two punch of magic and technology can save Doc, Brock--and perhaps the planet--from certain doom as the boys recruit The Order of the Triad and Pete White to get to the bottom of a thirty year old mystery.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Bored and under-whelmed with his new Guild-assigned arch-enemies, The Monarch seeks to re-spark his old hatred by secretly visiting the Venture Compound while Dr. Venture is away at the Science Now conference. His passion for arching all things Venture may threaten to seriously cool things with his other love, Dr. Mrs. The Monarch, but does it really count as arching when there's nobody home? Or is there?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Determined to honor the father he never knew, Jonas, Jr. converts Spider Skull Island into a Team Venture Museum. Unfortunately, he invited all of his father's surviving friends and enemies to the grand opening. There's nothing like a party to stir up decades worth of sibling rivalries, bitter regrets and half-forgotten hatreds.

programme.sub-title: Family That Slays Together, Stays Together Part I, The

programme.sub-title: Family That Slays Together, Stays Together Part II, The

programme.sub-title: Blood of the Father, Heart of Steel

But Dr. Venture is focused completely on Dean, who is taking his first steps in joining the family business as a Super Scientist. But someone else wants Dr. Venture's attention, too: A shadowy figure from Dr. Venture's past who is out to steal Dean's future.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

But tonight, all bets are off as Henchman 21 begins the hunt for the murderer of Henchman 24. Alliances shift, secrets are revealed, and the Venture brothers are kidnapped. Again.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture isn't feeling himself lately...he's killing himself. Orpheus suspects it's an inside job and pries the Venture family from their touch football game to help him teach Doc the value of self-love.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: What's more frightening than a doll that wants to kill you with a broken bottle? What's more perilous than a car that has no brakes and is aimed at your torso? What brings more sleepless nights than the threat of chlymidia? The PROM! The Venture boys embrace societies most feared school dance in this hour long danger-pile. Will they live to look back at their rented suits with horror?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: One of Dr. Venture's old inventions seems to have gotten a mind of its own, so General Manhowers sends him to Central America to fix it. The Ventures must all confront their own hearts of darkness if they're to survive what's waiting for them in the jungle.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Seven of the world's greatest heroes stop being polite--and start getting real--in "The Real World: Metropolis." Icons from Star Trek and Tiger Beat alike unite for canned sitcom laughs in "Two Kirks, a Khan and a Pizza Place." Jesus Christ hunts down his greatest nemesis, Tarantino-style, in "Kill Bunny." The hottest game show from Japan is here: "Who Poop Last?" The legends of rock 'n' roll return from beyond the grave to haunt the "Zombie Idol" reality show.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The last surviving member of N*Sync, Joey Fatone, must avenge his murdered bandmates in a deadly martial arts tournament.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The roller-coaster celebrity life of the Incredible Hulk is profiled in "Hollywood Spotlight." The Masters of the Universe are rocked by a Paris Hilton-style sex tape.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: William Shatner's toupee has adventures the action star can only dream of. Heaven's not all it's cracked up to be in "Can We Handle the Truth?" Hilary Duff's new film combines history and teen drama in an updated The Diary of Anne Frank. The fates of the greatest action figure toy lines from decades past are exposed in "Where Are They Now?"

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: "The World's Most One-Sided Fistfights" get wild at Mardi Gras. Benjamin Franklin grapples with historical figures like the Wright Brothers and Mahatma Gandhi in "Educational Wrestling Federation."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The world's most famous monkey busts loose on Skull Island in "Ding Dong, King Kong." Scandalous Hollywood news and gossip get the Pat O'Brien treatment. The Smurfs are terrorized by a serial killer in "Murder in Smurf Town X."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Sailor Moon encounters a bone-chilling villain. A nerd wins a date with famous actress Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Michael Knight's talking car parties hard in "KITT's Day Out." A brawl rocks the nursing home in "Grandma Fu." Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen unite to fight a rampaging dragon. George Jetson's murder takes center stage in "Unsolved Case Files: I, Rosie."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The classic film Jaws gets a special edition DVD. Scandal at the North Pole is revealed in "Unsolved Case Files: Claus & Effect." The A-Team solves its problems with maximum firepower and minimal intelligence.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: A video dating experience takes a turn for the worse. An Oriental massage also takes a turn for the worse.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: "It's Alien vs. Predator on the battleground of love in a special episode of "First Date." See what the future holds in "Carousel of Tomorrow." Popeye experiences a world without his hamburger-leeching friend in "It's a Wimpy-Filled Life." The modern video game Halo invades the old-school classic Donkey Kong. Mrs. McNally's third-graders present: Tim Burton's The Corpse Bride. The truth about Ponda Baba's bad day."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Dean Devlin and Roland Emmerich re-make Godzilla... again. A crime-fighting monkey saves monkeys from a monkey supervillain. An average fellow named Doug wakes up in the world of the Huggytime Bears.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Napoleon Dynamite pops up as a famous figure from history. Fizzing candy has terrible repercussions for young Mikey. A weakling turns into the "King of the Beach" with some illegal help.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken gets un-canceled! Learn tips for fighting... terrorism! Mexico builds its greatest hero in The Six Million Peso Man. Skater McGee is a re-animated corpse, an extreme re-animated corpse!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: A time-traveling jerk wreaks havoc on history. Lion-O, leader of the ThunderCats, suffers as an Earth pet. Clifford the Big Red Dog gets in big, red trouble. Evel Knievel wows his nursing home.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Fred and Barney brawl over a box of Fruity Pebbles. Kids have fun with the Phyllis Diller Spray-n-Play. An Egyptian pharaoh builds a pyramid of Legos.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Mexico builds its greatest hero in The Six Million Peso Man. That old dancing guy from the Six Flags commercials saves-and ruins-the day. Two aliens from Space Invaders revolt. A cleaning woman finds the Batcave the hard way. Lindsay Lohan enters the world of Highlander and battles teen starlet foes.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: People of all ages love the new toy, Morning Wood! A man's groin is possessed in Idle Nuts. Live in fear when a giant midget attacks! A cleaning woman finds the Batcave the hard way. Atreyu and Falcor kick off a Neverending Party! An evening news broadcast spins out of control.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Twinkie the Kid dispenses justice-and lead! Popular board games from Chutes and Ladders to Hungry Hungry Hippos get turned into action-packed feature films. Meet Skeletor's dentist, Mo-Larr!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Learn the secret life of Pokemon's Pikachu! Stupid kids get a new high from "numb-chucking." A checkers champion goes on the adventure of a lifetime. Meet Eagle Eye Smith, the blind athlete who will touch your heart. Then meet the Four My Little Ponys of the Apocalypse. A kid gets a used-car surprise: a Tron cycle! The Golden Girls share their sexual escapades a la Sex and the City.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Southern-fried funerals get exciting thanks to Dixie Joe! The Booger Man makes a mess. Frankenstein's in-laws are less than pleased. Order your movie tickets from Fan-Dingo--the paper bags want you to. The cast of Final Fantasy VII get jobs at a burger chain. A young soccer player named Ricky faces life's obstacles. Bugs Bunny goes hip-hop in 8 Carrot.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Senior Mutant Ninja Turtles rock the nursing home! Cuddles the fabric softener bear gets the wrong kind of hug. Monkeys explore outer space on a budget. George W. Bush discovers he has Jedi powers. And we're back with more of those stupendous bloopers, including audition tapes from MTV's Jackass!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Care Bears care a lot-about ethnic cleansing. See the action-packed story of Heimlich and his quest to unblock your windpipe. Rick Schroeder is fighting crime in style in the new hit series Rick Shaw. Ben Affleck sues the AFLAC duck. Corporate disputes get solved hand-to-hand in Office Fighter. Harry Potter uses magic to fight... puberty!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The legendary Kraken sea monster learns freedom isn't all it's krak-ed up to be. A kid has a fantastic dream about a bear. Weird Al Yankovic's "Weasel Stomping Day" gets a Robot Chicken video treatment! Playmobil cowboys search for new frontiers. A day at the ballpark proves why radio sucks. The wishes of children come true, with dire results. The crew of the Starship Enterprise faces their greatest foes yet-themselves!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Young Young Indiana Jones finds treasure at his elementary school. Rainbow Brite reveals her dark side. Montezuma gets his revenge, and the results smell terrible. Malibu Barbie learns why you don't build your Dream House in Malibu. Rom: Spaceknight meets his ultimate nemesis! Into the Blue gets a relevant skewering. Hulk Hogan busts out of prison camp in Hogan's Heroes.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The classic movie Beastmaster takes Broadway by storm. Mrs. McNally's third-graders present: Tim Burton's The Corpse Bride.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Lil' Hitler will win your heart! The Library of Heaven yields answers even God doesn't want you to know. The Burger King serves up some delicious B&E. Garfield and Heathcliff take each other to court. A giraffe deals with the stages of death. Action Jackson endorses laundry detergent. Never pick up a hitchhiking pig! The gang from Police Academy joins the X-Men.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Learn the secret life of Batman villain the Penguin. Kids will love playing with My Stalker! Orlando Bloom must help his fellow passengers survive after a plane crash. Meet Cork, the world's greatest retarded detective! Jesus and the Argonauts find action and adventure, and turn their backs on it. The Micronauts climb a mountain. The U.S. government declares war on Christmas.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken whores itself out to corporate America. Snow Job finds his specialized skills aren't in high demand with G.I. Joe. Thing grows up and leaves the Adams Family nest. The Memory Game challenges the brainpower of contestants, and the penalty for failure is death! The Black Stallion teaches us about race relations. Oprah and Dr. Phil team up in the greatest buddy cop movie ever!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Young Victor Frankenstein attempts to bring his cat back to life. The I Think We Should Just be Friends Fairy ruins a guy's life. Cameron Diaz has just 24 hours to live! Calvin and Hobbes have fun therapy adventures. A game of Marco Polo gets out of hand. Mario and Luigi stumble into the violent world of Grand Theft City.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Mr. T and the Foo Fighters forge an unlikely alliance. Stretch Armstrong needs a corn syrup transplant. A mermaid shows a surface boy the wonders of Atlantis. A guy dates his GPS navigational system. Learn the untold origin of Alvin and the Chipmunks! Roger Ebert and guest reviewer M. Night Shyamalan present upcoming feature films, including Schindler's List 2: Schindler's Pissed.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The zombie Robot Chicken staff gets back to work! The Defenders of the Earth accept their limitations. The Decepticon Soundwave discovers he's a little dated. Shout On and Shout Off with The Shouter! You can be a loser at The Game of Life. Governor Schwarzenegger investigates the illegal immigration issue with Speedy Gonzales and Dora the Explorer.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Law & Order has never been chicken... until now. President Bush gets a Gremlin, and the world suffers. Don't miss The 33-Year-Old Virgin, starring Jesus. Smokey the Bear remembers where he got his name. Stan Lee and Pamela Anderson reveal super-powered gossip on Superheroes Tonight.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Ted Kennedy and Jenna Jameson battle celebrities in politics and porn! Link's looking for a decent reward from Princess Zelda. The Homeless Airlines sorta takes flight. Learn whatever happened to the Micro Machines Man. Skeletor's latest plot against Eternia and He-Man goes a little too well.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Another Black Man in a Fat Suit movie. Big Jim tries to score. A cat in a hat has his way with the family pet and the kids need to get lost. When Snarf kicks it, Mumm-Ra sees his chance to destroy The Thundercats as Lion-O's new nanny.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The dinosaurs face their Armageddon. Barbie and a Brat go head-to-head on MTV's Exposed. What happens on Tuesday, when Wimpy has to pay for his burgers? Greatest American Hero, or Greatest American Nerd? Find out how infinite wealth has affected Richie Rich's teenage years.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: An alien invasion isn't quite what it seems. Haunted Houses are common, but not one with THIS kind of ghost! Can Bob the Builder take on the mafia? Probably. "Inside The Battlefield" revisits G.I. Joe's and Cobra's battle of the Weather Dominator, 20 years later.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Our PS3 Contest winner gets what's coming to him. Mr. Rogers is turning Japanese. Spawn faces the Devil with his one true skill - fiddling. Fonzie takes care of Cha-Chi the best he can in The Pursuit of Happy Days. Iron Man's feet become his greatest weakness. VH1's "Top 100 Final Episodes" features the end of Mork & Mindy, Love Boat and more.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Empire Strikes Back's Lando Calrissian led our heroes into a dinnertime trap with Darth Vader, and hilarity's the main course! In the spirit of 300 comes 1776. Michael Moore uncovers whatever happened to the girls' toys of yesteryear.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Michelin Man helps out... with his life! Crystar, the Crystal Warrior, gets smoked! Thelma and Louise regret their suicidal ways. The Maytag Repairman's life REALLY sucks. The Laff-A-Lympics gang face their darkest games ever: Munich, 1972.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Kool-Aid Man quenches some inconvenient thirsts. The mystery of why Encyclopedia Brown's parents aren't getting along. What new realm will D&D's Venger conquer next? Wonder Woman reveals her revealing arch-enemy. Celebrities are drunk, but that's not why they go to rehab-they go to conquer the world! (Or something.)

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Never seek the help of She-Ra, Princess of Power, when she's on her period. Danny and the gang from Grease are building a new kind of sex-machine. The Intensive Care Bears care more than their HMO will allow. The E.T. video game almost killed Atari, and his next target... is you! Nobody in Smurf Village ever expected the dam to break... the poor bastards.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: ...Christmas Special: Hermey the Elf sucks at being a dentist. All Sally wants is a love note, but for Linus it's Misery. A nerd is stuffed into a locker and into the magical and confusing land of Narnia.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Super Friends make way for The Super Pets. The Carmen Sandiego host has girlfriend troubles. Pac-Man learns that he's been living in the Matrix. The car version of Voltron get to the rescue as fast as it can. The Cenobites guest star on Girls Gone Wild. 24 focuses on the night hours as Drac takes down the terrorists.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Conan tells us "What is Best in Life" with a song. The Nerds find out Revenge comes with a price. President Jenna Bush trades the Oil Crisis for the Corn Crisis. The Saved By The Bell kids meet Jigsaw from Saw, and Screech will never be the same. The Borg track the Enterprise to its hiding place-Las Vegas' "Star Trek Experience".

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Sylar gets a new power in a Heroes parody. Mr. Magoo gets Laser Eye Surgery. Tarzan learns that not everything humans can teach him are as good as Jane's boobs. When Paris Hilton was stuck in prison, it was up to Nicole Richie to stage a Prison Break.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Vic Mackey from The Shield switches places with the Fantastic Four's Thing and it's funny. Cowboys on a cattle drive have it bad in biblical proportions. Bronson Pinchot and Ludacris star in the off-Broadway production of "Don't Be Ridiculous". Fraggle Rock meets Watership Down when the Fraggles are forced out of their home and onto a desperate hunt for survival.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Diggers have Dug their own grave, Dig Dug-style, ya dig? You've never seen a Vegas crime caper like Ocean's Thirty-Eight. The government tries to contain an outbreak of cooties. Teenagers are exposed to movie trailers, but they're not exactly watching the screen.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The latest Japanese commercial for a yeast infection cream needs a famous pitch-woman. The enemies of America are on the run as President Bush becomes... Captain Texas! If only the Kryptonians had watched Jor-El's Inconvenient Kryptonian Truth. Sir Mix-A-Lot knows what King Arthur needs! A Glo Worm saves the day when a blackout strikes. We dedicate the season to the staff we've lost... and killed.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken returns for its fourth season, with the help of guest stars Joss Whedon, Ron Moore and Seth MacFarlane! Tila Tequila's "A Shot at Love" reveals a deadly secret. The creators imagine: what if Parappa the Rapper had to rap for his life? Movie and TV favorites are trimmed down to "Just the Good Parts."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine the contractor in charge of building those awesome Indiana Jones temples, Jason Voorhees gets ready for Friday the 13th, witness another death of another salesman and what might happen when the Justice League of America suffers through "Bring a Sidekick to Work Day."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Witness the aftermath of Pluto Nash box office. The creators imagine the truth behind James Bond's sex life, Iron Man's unexpected ally and a Skeletor plot involving a less-than-perfect clone.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Find out the only way to kill a werewolf! Discover the secret origin of Composite Santa Claus! The creators imagine a deleted scene from "Daredevil" movie, and what might happen if Hannah Montana had a date... with murder!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Joey Fatone pitches his idea for a sketch, Gobots prove they're no Transformers, the creators imagine where Billy Joel might get his musical inspiration from and who you might call if The A-Team's not available.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine how Babar might rule with an iron tusk, where O.J. might search for his ex-wife's killer and what Skynet might send back as their next Terminator, plus check out the latest superhero movie.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine Zeus spicing up The Clash of the Titans.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Giving Tree has much to give, everyone loves InuYasha plus the creators imagine what happens when Punky Brewster discovers boys and who Stephen King's new neighbor might be.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine how Freddy Krueger got his start, what would happen if the Monchhichis drew first blood, how Criss Angel delivers the Ultimate Mind Freak, and what a day with the Living Lohans might be like.

programme.title: Robot Chicken

programme.title: Robot Chicken

programme.title: Robot Chicken

All this and more from the minds of the creators.

programme.title: Robot Chicken

programme.desc: As Europe falls to Nazi control and America reels from Pearl Harbor, early Allied battles from Guadalcanal to North Africa unfold through Charles Scheffel in Tunisia and Jack Werner in the northern Pacific.

programme.title: Greatest Tank Battles
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Kursk: Northern Front
programme.desc: Summer of 1943: Hitler launches a massive, armoured offensive to regain the upper hand on the Eastern Front. This is the story of the Russian defense stalling a panzer onslaught on the Northern shoulder of the Kursk salient.

programme.title: Missions That Changed the War: Germany's Last Ace
programme.desc: 5/12/44 -- U.S. fighter group - Zemke's "Wolf Pack" - uses new tactics, changing the course of the air war over Europe. This day brings a fateful encounter between Col. Hubert Zemke, double ace Robert Ranking, & Germany's fighter ace Gunther Rall.

programme.title: Dictators Hideouts
programme.desc: Investigate Viktor Yanukovych's lavish Mezhyhirya estate, including its hidden tunnels, extravagant facilities and links to corruption.

programme.title: Hitler's Gold
programme.desc: As World War II ended, the hunt for the Nazi criminals began. Amid a battle for justice, there was also the search for the property the Nazis had stolen.

programme.title: Cold War Armageddon
programme.desc: In 1989, the USSR pulls out of Afghanistan and the last remaining proxy conflict of the Cold War ends. A new era emerges as brutal barriers are broken down. A peaceful transition is what the watching world prays for, but is by no means a sure thing.

programme.title: Dictators Hideouts
programme.desc: Explore the massive Casa Poporului and its underground bunker network, built under Romanian dictator Nicolae Ceausescu.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: As Civil War casualties rise, Lincoln searches for a decisive general and begins shaping a vision for the nation's future and its freed slaves.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle
programme.desc: The daring Delta Force prison rescue in Panama showcases the precision, speed and tactics behind a high-risk close-quarter operation.

programme.title: Greatest Tank Battles
programme.sub-title: The Battle of the Bulge: SS Panzers Attack!
programme.desc: December 1944: An infamous SS tank force leads Hitler's final offensive in the west. This is the story of the Sixth Panzer Army's incredible breakthrough of the American line and subsequent encirclement and defeat.

programme.title: Doolittle’s Raiders: A Final Toast
programme.desc: On April 4, 1942, the Doolittle Tokyo Raiders accomplished a daring mission. The aviators took the fight directly to Japan for the first time in WWII - Payback for its sneak attack on Pearl Harbor. Hosted by Gary Sinise.

programme.title: The Nazi War Machine of WWII
programme.desc: The story of the creation of the Nazi War Machine, tracing their origins from street thugs battling in the German streets after The Great War. We show the growth of the Panzer Corps, the mighty Luftwaffe, and the feared SS.

programme.title: Cold War Armageddon
programme.desc: By the end of the 70s, war between East and West has been raging for decades. Countless proxy wars have proven how destructive this so-called Cold War can be. It's an arms race, a propaganda battle and at times a deadly game.

programme.title: Venezuela, Vignettes of the Orenoco Mission
programme.desc: The Orinoco is one of the most important rivers in South America. It originates in Venezuela and mainly crosses this country with the third largest water flow in the world before reaching the Atlantic in the state of Delta Amacuro. This state is the second least populated in Venezuela, which is easy to understand since most of its more than 40,000 square kilometers is just water and forest. Capuchin missionaries arrived in the early 20th century and established the first missionary center, Mission de Caroní, in Araguaimujo, in 1925. Many of those who reached first died of malaria and yellow fever. Of the missionaries who arrived in the 1950s, few are still alive; however, new missionaries have arrived and others continue to arrive to support the work of evangelism.

programme.title: Venezuela, Vignettes of the Orenoco Mission
programme.desc: The Orinoco is one of the most important rivers in South America. It originates in Venezuela and mainly crosses this country with the third largest water flow in the world before reaching the Atlantic in the state of Delta Amacuro. This state is the second least populated in Venezuela, which is easy to understand since most of its more than 40,000 square kilometers is just water and forest. Capuchin missionaries arrived in the early 20th century and established the first missionary center, Mission de Caroní, in Araguaimujo, in 1925. Many of those who reached first died of malaria and yellow fever. Of the missionaries who arrived in the 1950s, few are still alive; however, new missionaries have arrived and others continue to arrive to support the work of evangelism.

programme.title: 13 Razones para amar la vida
programme.desc: No hay amor más grande que el que da la vida por los amigos. Jesús es el amigo por excelencia. Los amigos son benevolentes. Tu amigo te escucha, te regala su tiempo. Orando por ti…está trabajando por ti. Escuchar es un oficio divino. El amigo también conversa, del verbo versa y con. El dolor cuando se comparte con el amigo es más fácil de llevar. Cada amigo es la presencia de Cristo. Cuida la amistad. Otra razón para amar al vida.

programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. programme.desc: In this episode of Mysteries of the Messiah, we delve into the lives of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and uncover the hidden prophetic messages woven into their stories. We learn that God called Abraham to be a new Adam and Sarah a new Eve, with promises of descendants, wealth, and greatness. Isaac's name, meaning "laughter," symbolizes that nothing is impossible with God, and his near-sacrifice foreshadows the sacrifice of the Messiah. Jacob's encounter with the stone prophecy reveals the manifestation of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. These interconnected tales point to the ultimate Messiah.

programme.title: American Trends & Lifestyle Episode 14
programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, our new host Lauren Makk gets into the Halloween spirit with a look at Orlando’s seasonal fun and steps into the magical world of Willy Wonka. Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. We’ll also share important information to help those living with asthma better understand and manage their condition.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 639
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. Plus, we share tips for protecting loved ones from online scams, managing fall allergens at home, and helping teen drivers stay safer behind the wheel. We’ll also travel to Costa Rica for a luxurious escape inspired by coffee traditions and head to Hong Kong for a colorful look at its Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations.

programme.title: 2023 YETI National Championships: Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: 2023 YETI Climbing National Championships: Lead Semi-Finals. The 2023 YETI Climbing National Championships takes place in Boise, Idaho, and will bring many of America’s best competitive climbers together, including Olympic and National Team members, and will provide a first look at some of the athletes that will be working their way toward the top of the climbing rankings.

programme.title: Climbing Guide Books vs. Apps
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor, Gavin Feek, discusses his article about climbing guide books and their future alongside newer climbing apps, as well as the rise of AI. He describes the ethical concerns related to new digital climbing guides compared to their older counterparts.

programme.title: Debunking Bio Plastics
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Maine where she meets up with local climber Erin OToole and Marine Research Scientist Abby Barrows who are doing their part in areas of sustainability and conservation. Sasha sees firsthand how businesses and individuals can work to make Maine and our world a better place.

programme.title: How to Transfer a Belay
programme.desc: Silas Rossi, IFMGA/AMGA Mountain Guide, walks through the steps to transfer a belay. First, ensure the climber is in a secure position and not hanging on the rope. Next, tie a clove hitch in the brake hand side of the rope and attach it to your belay loop with a locking carabiner. Next, transfer the belay device to the belay loop of the new belayer. Once you’ve checked it, untie the clove hitch and proceed with belaying.

programme.title: What to Look for When Buying Quickdraws
programme.desc: Professional climber, climbing guide, and Climbing contributor Genevive Walker covers what to look for when buying quickdraws. She covers quickdraw shape options (D-shaped and asymmetrical), solid gates v. wire gates, length, and alpine draws and anchor draws. She recommends you check your dogbone and carabiners for wear and tear, and know when it's time to retire them. Talking head show-and-tell with the different kids of draws.

programme.title: The Unexpected Ways this Dirtbag Fund Grant Recipient Used his Funding
programme.desc: Emilio Taiveaho, a climber from North Carolina and a recipient of the Dirtbag Fund grant, shares reflections from his experiences pre- and post-winning the Dirtbag Fund. While he didn't spend the funds exactly how he had anticipated, he was stoked to be part of the first round of fund recipients, and his stoke is still high.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes on "The Sound"
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes film about the making of "The Sound", a 2025 survival horror film about a group of climbers embarking on a dangerous climb that has been off-limits for years.

programme.title: Multi-Pitch Route
programme.desc: Sasha heads to Eldorado Canyon with Laura Capps to climb the multi-pitch route Vertigo. She discovers the practical functionality of Vapur water bottles and then grabs lunch at Zeal food in Boulder.

programme.title: 30-Foot Fall from a Broken Hold: Weekend Whipper, Episode 14
programme.desc: In this episode of Weekend Whipper, Climber Noah Kane falls 30 feet after a hold breaks the 5th pitch of El Sendero Luminoso in El Portrero Chico Mexico. UGC footage with graphics.

programme.title: The Valley Boy: The Story of Grant Cline
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor Gavin Feek reports on the late Gavin Cline, an 18-year-old who sadly passed away [Grant fell to his death in an accident at Royal Arches]. Grant was a prominent member of the Yosemite climbing community, living in employee housing within the park and working at the Lodge. Gavin nods to the fuller story in his article and shares imagery of Grant, his loved ones, and his living quarters in Yosemite National Park.

programme.title: Indigenous Ice Climbers: The Cholitas of Bolivia
programme.desc: Minidoc about the strides of the Cholitas Escaladoras, a group of female, Indigenous ice climbers in Bolivia which was founded in 2015. Cholitas leader and co-founder Cecilia Llusco shares the successes the women have had in increasing visibility for the Indigenous Aymara women of Bolivia, who have faced femicide and discrimination, by summiting large mountains "en pollera" (wearing traditional skirts and clothing). Cecilia's big dream is to summit Mount Everest. Follow Cecilia and a fellow Cholita as they climb Huayna Potosí, a 6,088-meter peak near El Alto, Bolivia. This peak inspired Cecilia's mission as a young girl.

programme.title: Choosing a Personal Anchor System
programme.desc: Silas Rossi, IFMGA/AMGA Mountain Guide and owner of Alpine Logic, discusses different personal anchors (also known as personal tethers or abbreviated as PAS). He recommends the Petzl Dual Connect Adjust, as well as the Petzl Connect Adjust as options, and also demonstrates the Metolius Personal Anchor System, and the Kong SLYDE as a more economical option. He also explains pros and cons of creating a personal anchor with a cordalette or a 4-foot runner or sling. Read the full story at www.climbing.com/gear/no-one-size-fits-all-personal-anchor

programme.title: Climbing in Moab
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian wakes up in Moab and gets a morning crack climb in, then cruises back to Denver for an afternoon training session with Dave Wahl at Movement Climbing Gym.

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2024 YETI National Championships will be held at the USA Climbing National Training Center in Salt Lake City, UT. Join us to cheer for Team USA and the world’s best competition climbers as IFSC World Cups return to Salt Lake City. The Boulder and Speed World Cup returns May 3-5, while the Paraclimbing World Cup returns May 7-8.

programme.title: How to Paint Bolts
programme.desc: Bolt painting lesson with Evan Wisheropp, a route developer, professional climber, and photographer. On the route 'Shark Bait', a 5.12c in California, Evan demonstrates how he camouflages bolts and their surrounding, often garish paint with the help of rock-matching paint and chalk, giving lots of tips and takeaways. Then he climbs the route he has freshly painted!

programme.title: Episode 13, Weekend Whipper - The Triple Ripper
programme.desc: Michael Scarborough is nearly at the top of “Gettin’ Schooled,” a 5.12c finger crack by Evan Wisheropp in Long Canyon, when he falls, ripping out three microcams from the sandstone. A yellow Black Diamond nut catches his fall in this week’s Weekend Whipper.

programme.title: Sending a 5.14c Just Over 4 Months After Giving Birth
programme.desc: Jenya Kazbekova, Ukrainian Pro Climber & Former Olympian, discusses her send on Necessary Evil, a 5.14c/8c+ sport route in Arizona’s Virgin River Gorge. Jenya’s daughter Taisiia was born in August 2025, and she climbed throughout the pregnancy, and got right back to the sport afterwards as well. Jenya took just five sessions to redpoint Necessary Evil before sending it, her second 8c+ route. Her first, The Güllich, is in Russian annexed Crimea. Jenya is looking forward to representing Ukraine at the Olympics in 2028 and hopes to be able to go back to her country soon.

programme.title: How Mary Eden Became the Crack Queen
programme.desc: Mary Eden, Pro Climber & Instructor, discusses her past climbing wins as she gears up to climb Century Crack, the world's hardest natural roof crack. She sent Necronomicon (5.14a) in 2022 and Black Mamba (5.14b) in 2023. Eden describes the way she approaches climbing, and her outlook on the sport as a positive and uplifting community.

programme.title: Taking a Peak
programme.desc: Pro climbers Alex Honnold and Cedar Wright battle wind and a surprise snowstorm in Great Basin National Park. When the weather clears, Alex explores Ely's growing biking scene and stargazes beneath some of the darkest skies in America.

programme.title: 2024 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: Lead Semi-Finals from Gaithersburg, MD. The USA Climbing National Team Trials for 2024 will take place at Sportrock Climbing Centers in Gaithersburg, MD from March 5th to March 8th. This prestigious event will showcase the top climbers in the country as they compete in three disciplines: Boulder, Lead, and Speed. The two highest-ranked U.S. athletes will earn a coveted spot on the U.S. National Team for 2024, allowing them to compete on the IFSC World Cup circuit. Some may even have the chance to compete in the Olympic Qualifying Series, where they will vie for additional spots on Team USA.

programme.title: Beneath The Ice
programme.desc: A story of curiosity, exploration and climate research inside the Greenland ice cap. Canadian adventurer, Will Gadd, uses his ice climbing skills to lead a scientific expedition into a previously unexplored territory beneath the ice sheet.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Rappelling and Passing Knots CLIMB 18 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills, and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro Karsten Delap teaches you how to rappel in different situations as well as pass the knot in an emergency.

programme.title: Speaking out Against Bullying
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian's Tuesday plans are turned upside down when she has to return from a climbing trip to Nice in order to see her grandmother before she passes. During an already trying week, Sasha is tested by cyber bullying and makes the courageous choice to address the issue head on.

programme.title: 2024 Paraclimbing Finals: Session One | USA Climbing
programme.desc: Paraclimbing Finals: Session One from Gaithersburg, MD. USA Climbing will hold the 2024 Paraclimbing Nationals Championships on March 9-10 at Sportrock Climbing Center Rio in Gaithersburg, MD. Paraclimbing National Championships will be a two-round competition hosting a modified redpoint qualification round on day one and an onsight final round on day two. The climbing will be executed on top rope.

programme.title: Intro to Trad: Safe Descents CLIMB 14 | Outside Learn

Read the full story here: https://www.climbing.com/culture-climbing/sustainable-climbing-holds-mushrooms-bioresins-recycled-plastic/

programme.title: Climbing's Newest Hotbed | No Days Off

The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: How to Make a Solid Tape Glove

programme.title: Episode 6 | Weekend Whipper | Ripping Cams in a Swedish Finger Crack

programme.title: The Blind Ascensionist

This thrill seeker will take us on a journey of learning to navigate our world legally blind while pushing past any barrier or boulder in his way en route to becoming a World Champion Climber who continues to pursue a new challenge at every turn. Through Justin’s narration, viewers will be drawn into his mindset as he navigates through his physical, mental, and emotional barriers, only to find the strength to push past any “boulders” put in front of him. Grab your skis and find out how to scorch up the slopes even during the coldest, snowiest winter days.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Winter Fever (1979)
programme.desc: Feeling sick this winter, well don’t worry we have the perfect cure for you ailment, Warren Miller’s Winter Fever. Follow along as some of the best skiers of the time like Junior Bounous, Suzie Patterson, Penelope Street, and Scotty Brooksbank show you some of the most classic and purest techniques from the early stages of extreme skiing. Travel all around and visit places like New Mexico, Crested Butte, Snowbasin, Mt. Baker, Wisconsin, Lake Placid, and Canada. If you start to feel a little hot and bothered after this movie don’t worry, you just got a little case of Winter Fever.

programme.title: Chicks That Rip
programme.desc: Professional female skiers take on the toughest terrain, make a name for themselves and show s just not the guys that are pushing the boundaries of skiing and riding.

programme.title: Due South
programme.desc: Doug Stoup, world famous ski guide, organizes an expedition to Antarctica, but the trip is stopped in its tracks as the boat is unable to depart, leaving a group of incredibly dejected skiers with nowhere to go but home.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Winter People (1972)
programme.desc: Join Warren Miller for one of his most classic ski films to date. Meet the cast of skiers like Scott Brooksbank, Phil Davis, Lane Monroe, Hal O’Leary, John Truden, Skeeter Zoberski and many more as they ski around the world and show you why they are true Winter People. Journey to places like Chamonix, Bear Valley, Mammoth, Le Meuire, Sugarloaf, and tons of other great places to ski and see first hand where the great sport of skiing originated.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Winter Starts Now (2021)
programme.desc: The 72nd annual ski and snowboard film from Warren Miller Entertainment will chase winter from coast to coast with friends old and new in the places that keep our spirits high no matter what life throws at us. From Alaska’s Prince William Sound, where the only first tracks you’ll encounter belong to bears, to Maine’s community of craftsmen and women devoted to sliding on snow. We’re sharing the dreams of Olympic ambitions and the resolve of adaptive athletes. Follow big mountain skiers Marcus Caston and Connery Lundin on a road trip of a lifetime up to Alaska. Catch up with speed riding legend JT Holmes and meet new friends like Madison Ostergren and Vasu Sojitra. Get stoked because winter starts now. Level up your winter with Warren Miller when you join Outside+.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Wintervention (2010)
programme.desc: Narrated by skiing icon Jonny Moseley, Warren Miller Entertainment’s 61st film – Warren Miller’s Wintervention – features acute cases of classic snow-diction from across the globe. There are the skiers who sail from Argentina to Antarctica searching for some of the last untouched descents on Earth. There are the skiers and riders who venture deep into the Caucasus Mountains of Georgia, chasing rumors they overheard in a language they don't speak and there are the skiers who tour far into the northern reaches of the Arctic Circle where they won't just climb peaks, they'll get their powder fix at the top of the planet. Featuring everything from terrain parks and lift-accessed fresh to the most exotic settings imaginable, Wintervention is the definitive solution for the snow-obsessed. Wintervention highlights the most trusted names in ripping – boards-certified riders like Chris Davenport, JJ Thomas, Lindsey Vonn and Hugo Harrison – and top young talent in the field – innovators like Andy Mahre, Jossi Wells and Zach Black.

programme.title: Warren Miller's 75 (2024)
programme.desc: Warren Miller is going big for 75 years! Stacked with unbelievable action and unexpected stories, Warren Miller’s 75 will bring fans to powder stashes and chutes around the world, from Canada, Colorado, California, and Utah to Finland, Japan, Austria, and New Jersey. Catch a diverse lineup of snowsports legends, Olympic hopefuls, world champions, X Games stars, and emerging talents, including snowboarders Shaun White, Jeremy Jones, Danny Davis, and Toby Miller, plus skiers Max Hitzig, Lexi duPont, Caite Zeliff, Mark Abma, and Aaron Blunck. With original segments and unique collaborations, this year’s film sets the tone for the next 75 years of ski and snowboard filmmaking. Get ready for the celebration that is 75.

programme.desc: Hoping to prove herself to Animal Army, a militant activist organization led by the uncompromising Nasha, Mirthe secretly documents the grim reality inside a pig farm. Her evidence secures her place in the group and inspires a planned rescue mission, but when the activists return at night, the cages stand empty—the pigs killed before they could be freed. Enraged, Nasha pushes the group toward retaliation, targeting the farmer and anyone in their path. When the farmer discovers the intrusion, a violent confrontation erupts, leaving Mirthe caught between Nasha’s destructive vengeance and the farmer’s desperate attempts to protect his family. As the conflict escalates, Mirthe must decide what she is willing to do to survive the bloodshed.
